strings.subtitle: — Omusaanyizzi wa fayiro —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Okuwamba n'okuleka tewali. Kozesa bbaaputa wammanga.
strings.shred_button: S A A N Y I Z A
strings.ssd_warning:
Kulabula! Ku SSD, enkola y'okuwandiika waggulu tteekeddwa ku TRIM teykkiriza kusaanyiza.
Entegeka eno ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Fayiro "{name}" ejja kuwandiikibwa waggulu era esazibwe.

Weeyongere?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS emigendo gy'amakulu emirala (ADS) tegikolebwa.
• Ekitabo kya USN tekyerongoosebwa.
• Ebifaananyi by'ekisiikirize n'enkola z'ekire
  (OneDrive n'ebirala) tebikwatibwa.
strings.status_full: Ebirimu byawandiikibwa waggulu ddala ne ziiro. Okuzzaawo tekisoboka — ebikozesebwa bijja kulaba ziiro zokka.
strings.status_fast: Omutwe, omukira n'ennyiriri 4 MB byawandiikibwa waggulu. Ebirala tebikwatiddwa, naye olw'ebifo, okuzzaawo ddala n'ebikozesebwa by'abakozesa tekisoboka. Ku biwandiiko eby'ekyama kozesa enkola EJjuve.
strings.status_empty: Fayiro yali nkalu, okuwandiika waggulu tekwetaagisa. Esaziddwa.
strings.error_permission: Sisobola kutuuka ku fayiro. Eyinza okuba ng'eguddwamu mu ntegeka endala. Ggalawo oddeko.
strings.error_not_found: Fayiro tezuliddwa. Eyinza okuba ng'esaziddwa dda.
strings.error_is_symlink: Kino kye kikolo ky'akabonero. Ebikolo tebisobola kusaanyizibwa — fayiro ey'ekigendererwa ejja kusigala mirembe.
strings.error_reparse: Kino kye kifaananyi ky'ekifo (OneDrive oba kye kimu). Amakulu gaakyo gali mu kire, so si ku disiki — tewali kisaanyizibwa wano.
strings.error_not_file: Kino si fayiro (kabonero oba ekirala). Leka fayiro.
strings.error_hardlinks: Fayiro eno erina ebikolo ebigumu ebirala ({n} byonna). Ebikolo ebigumu tebirina mutwe — amannya gonna g'enkana. Bw'osaanyiza mu kkubo erya kaakano, amakulu gajja kuwandiikibwa waggulu ne gatemeddwa okutuuka 32 byte, naye ebyasigala bijja kutuukibwako mu bikolo ebirala. Sooka osaze ebikolo byonna.
strings.error_compressed:
Fayiro ekeddwa, esirikiddwa oba ntono. Okuwandiika waggulu ne ziiro tekikkiriza kusaanyiza amakulu amakadde kubanga NTFS agatereka mu ngeri endala.

Ggyawo enkola: nyiga ku ddyo → Enkola → Waggulu → ggyawo akabonero ka "Kunga" ne/oba "Sirika". Oluvannyuma ddamu SHREDDER.
